notes: Company background: mid-market SaaS that provides subscription billing + dunning automation for B2B SaaS companies. Heavy integration with Stripe + Zuora.

Primary use-case: Support/subscription agents that can take actions (refund, change plan, cancel, create invoice) via tool-calls to Stripe/Zuora. Need structured JSON outputs to feed into backend orchestration.
Latency SLO: Carlos (Head of Product) stated: 'Need sub-500ms end-to-end for a support agent happy path; streaming token latency p95 target ~200-300ms'.

POC goal: validate hosted_api streaming + function-calling to produce deterministic JSON payloads for Zuora connector, measure p50/p95/p99 for both streaming and final JSON assembly, track cost per support session.
Scaling path: start on Hosted API for quick iteration; evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and committed pricing once monthly sessions > ~50k or if stricter data isolation required.

Security: require SSO/SAML for admin access, SOC2 compliance, audit logs for actions, optional KMS for keys, and US data residency for payment data. EU residency noted for EU customers (future requirement).
Pricing: main blocker is committed pricing vs pay-as-you-go. Finance wants a 12mo ARR band and predictable unit cost for committed Dedicated SKU.
